english.notice_text: Dear Parents, In compliance with GRAP Stage III directives, outdoor sports and physical education today are replaced by indoor physical sessions (yoga, table tennis, fitness circuits) so children stay active away from polluted air.

hindi.notice_text: आदरणीय अभिभावक, ग्रैप स्टेज III के निर्देशों के अनुसार, आज खेल-कूद की बाहरी गतिविधियों की जगह इनडोर शारीरिक सत्र (योग, टेबल टेनिस, व्यायाम) होंगे, ताकि बच्चे प्रदूषित हवा से दूर सक्रिय रहें।

teacher.notice_text: Notice to Teachers: Today's timetable (2026-10-12) has been updated under GRAP Stage III. PE staff: please run the assigned indoor physical sessions in the indoor venues listed in today's plan.
